stories.title: Historians sue DOJ as Trump shrugs off law meant to preserve White House papers
stories.summary: The Trump administration asserts a nearly 50-year-old law requiring the preservation of federal government records is unconstitutional. Historians warn important papers could be destroyed.

stories.title: The 2026 NBA Playoffs start Saturday. Here's what to know
stories.summary: The NBA Playoffs begin Saturday, with the league's two best teams on the same side of the bracket. Meanwhile, for the league's worst teams, an all-time tanking season is finally over.

stories.title: Hormuz reopens, but insurers aren't ready to sound the all-clear
stories.summary: Insurance for cargo and oil vessels stuck in the Strait of Hormuz has skyrocketed. How can insurers help us understand the realities of the war with Iran?

stories.title: Where art thou?: Mapping Shakespeare's 1613 neighborhood
stories.summary: The recent discovery of a 17th century map provides new insight into the life of William Shakespeare.

stories.title: While in a detention cell, a young man heard a voice that allowed him to see hope
stories.summary: A man recalls the despair he felt when, as a college student, he tried to break into a building on campus and ended up in a detention cell. That's when he heard a voice that helped him find hope.

stories.title: Old Weezer and Chris Rainbow songs find a new life on TikTok
stories.summary: Old tracks hit the Billboard charts this week, thanks to online virality.
